unitTitle: Some - Any/Much - Many/A Few - A Little/Phrases of Quantity - Giving Advice - Conditionals Type 0 - Time Words

pairsWith.noteUz: Miqdor iboralari (a bar of, a carton of ...) va should/shouldn't mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 6-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (32-bet, PDF 31). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '6'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Phrases of Quantity':
6) 'Label the pictures with the words in the list, then use the words to fill in the gaps below.' a) bar, carton, slice, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jar, bag, box. SURATLAR: 1 mineral suv shishasi; 2 mayonez bankasi; 3 issiq choy piyolasi; 4 'CEREAL' qutisi; 5 shokolad plitkasi; 6 chipslar paketi; 7 sut kartoni; 8 sharbat stakani (nay bilan); 9 non bo'lagi; 10 sho'rva kosasi (qoshiq bilan). b) 1 a ...... of soup/salad/strawberries 2 a ...... of bread/cheese/cake 3 a ...... of cereal/eggs/biscuits 4 a ...... of chocolate/soap 5 a ...... of crisps/flour/sugar 6 a ...... of soda/wine/beer/orange juice 7 a ...... of milk/cream/orange juice 8 a ...... of water/lemonade/Coke 9 a ...... of coffee/tea/hot chocolate 10 a ...... of mayonnaise/honey/jam
7) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct word from the list.' bar, carton, slices, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jars, bag, box. 1 A: How many ...... of cheese would you like in your sandwich? B: Oh, just two, please.

O'NG USTUN:
2 A: Do we need anything from the shops? B: Yes, we need a ...... of washing powder. 3 A: Mum, can I have a ...... of chocolate, please? B: No, we're going to have dinner soon. 4 A: I'm going to give Mrs Seers a few ...... of home-made marmalade for the picnic. 5 A: Would you like a ...... of wine with your dinner? B: No, thank you. 6 A: Oh, how wonderful. A ...... of fresh strawberries. B: Yes, and I have some ice cream to go with them. 7 A: I'm tired. B: Well, I'll make you a nice ...... of hot chocolate before you go to bed. 8 A: Could you put this ...... of orange juice in the fridge, please? B: Of course. 9 A: Do we have enough flour for the cake? B: No, I think we should get one more ...... . 10 A: Don't forget to take a ...... of water with you to the beach. B: I won't.
'Giving Advice':
8) 'Make sentences using should/shouldn't, as in the example.' SURAT: soyabon-shlyapali bola plyajda. 1 Wear sunblock all over your body and face. 2 Bring a beach umbrella or find a spot on the beach where there is shade. 3 Wear a hat as well as sunglasses. 4 Don't stay out in the sun from 11:00 - 3:00 when the sun is very strong. 5 Don't go swimming immediately after eating. 6 Don't swim far away from the shore. Namuna: You should wear sunblock all over your body and face.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '32'.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with the words in the list: bar, carton, slice, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jar, bag, box. Pictures: 1 mineral water bottle; 2 mayonnaise jar; 3 cup of hot tea; 4 box of cereal; 5 bar of chocolate; 6 bag of crisps; 7 carton of milk; 8 glass of juice; 9 slice of bread; 10 bowl of soup.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan belgilang: bar, carton, slice, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jar, bag, box. Rasmlar: 1 mineral suv shishasi; 2 mayonez bankasi; 3 issiq choy piyolasi; 4 don mahsuloti qutisi; 5 shokolad plitkasi; 6 chipslar paketi; 7 sut kartoni; 8 sharbat stakani; 9 non bo'lagi; 10 sho'rva kosasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IDIShLAR va MIQDORLAR.

  1 BOTTLE - shisha (suv)
  2 JAR - banka (mayonez)
  3 CUP - piyola (choy)
  4 BOX - quti (don mahsuloti)
  5 BAR - plitka (shokolad)
  6 BAG - paket (chipslar)
  7 CARTON - karton quti (sut)
  8 GLASS - stakan (sharbat)
  9 SLICE - bo'lak (non)
  10 BOWL - kosa (sho'rva)


⚠ 'CRISPS':

  = chipslar (BrE; AmE - chips).

items.whyUz: ⚠ Karton quti - a carton of milk.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words to fill in the gaps below.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct word from the list: bar, carton, slices, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jars, bag, box.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'z bilan to'ldiring: bar, carton, slices, cup, bowl, glass, bottle, jars, bag, box.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOGLARDA MIQDOR IBORALARI.

  1 How many SLICES of cheese
    (ko'plik - 'just two')
  2 a BOX of washing powder
  3 a BAR of chocolate
  4 a few JARS of marmalade
    (ko'plik)
  5 a GLASS of wine
  6 A BOWL of fresh strawberries
  7 a nice CUP of hot chocolate
  8 this CARTON of orange juice
  9 one more BAG (of flour)
  10 a BOTTLE of water


⚠ 'WASHING POWDER':

  = kir yuvish kukuni.


⚠ 'HOME-MADE MARMALADE':

  = uyda tayyorlangan murabbo
  (sitrus).

items.sentence: A: How many ___ of cheese would you like in your sandwich? B: Oh, just two, please.
items.uz: Sendvichingizga nechta bo'lak pishloq? - Ikkita.

items.sentence: A: Do we need anything from the shops? B: Yes, we need a ___ of washing powder.
items.uz: Do'kondan biror narsa kerakmi? - Ha, bir quti kir yuvish kukuni.

items.sentence: A: Mum, can I have a ___ of chocolate, please? B: No, we're going to have dinner soon.
items.uz: Oyi, bir plitka shokolad bersangiz? - Yo'q, tez orada ovqatlanamiz.

items.sentence: A: I'm going to give Mrs Seers a few ___ of home-made marmalade for the picnic.
items.uz: Sirs xonimga piknik uchun bir necha banka uy murabbosini bermoqchiman.

items.sentence: A: Would you like a ___ of wine with your dinner? B: No, thank you.
items.uz: Kechki ovqatga bir stakan vino ichasizmi? - Yo'q, rahmat.

items.sentence: A: Oh, how wonderful. A ___ of fresh strawberries. B: Yes, and I have some ice cream to go with them.
items.uz: Qanday ajoyib. Bir kosa yangi qulupnay. - Ha, muzqaymoq ham bor.

items.sentence: A: I'm tired. B: Well, I'll make you a nice ___ of hot chocolate before you go to bed.
items.uz: Charchadim. - Uxlashdan oldin bir piyola issiq shokolad qilib beraman.

items.sentence: A: Could you put this ___ of orange juice in the fridge, please? B: Of course.
items.uz: Bu quti apelsin sharbatini muzlatgichga qo'ya olasizmi? - Albatta.

items.sentence: A: Do we have enough flour for the cake? B: No, I think we should get one more ___.
items.uz: Tort uchun un yetarlimi? - Yo'q, yana bir qop olishimiz kerak.

items.sentence: A: Don't forget to take a ___ of water with you to the beach. B: I won't.
items.uz: Plyajga bir shisha suv olishni unutma. - Unutmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using should/shouldn't, as in the example. 1 Wear sunblock all over your body and face. 2 Bring a beach umbrella or find a spot on the beach where there is shade. 3 Wear a hat as well as sunglasses. 4 Don't stay out in the sun from 11:00 - 3:00 when the sun is very strong. 5 Don't go swimming immediately after eating. 6 Don't swim far away from the shore.
exercises.instructionUz: Should/shouldn't bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 Butun tana va yuzga quyoshdan himoya kremi surting. 2 Plyaj soyaboni olib boring yoki soya joy toping. 3 Ko'zoynak bilan birga shlyapa ham kiying. 4 Quyosh juda kuchli bo'lganda, 11:00-3:00 orasida quyoshda qolmang. 5 Ovqatdan keyin darhol suzmang. 6 Qirg'oqdan uzoqqa suzmang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ → MASLAHAT.

  Wear ... → You SHOULD wear ...
  Don't ... → You SHOULDN'T ...

  1-3 tasdiq → should
  4-6 inkor → shouldn't


⚠ 'SUNBLOCK':

  = quyoshdan himoya kremi.


⚠ 'SHADE':

  = soya.


⚠ 'THE SHORE':

  = qirg'oq.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 You should wear sunblock all over your body and face.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Butun tana va yuzingizga quyoshdan himoya kremi surtishingiz kerak.
modelAnswers: 1 You should wear sunblock all over your body and face.
2 You should bring a beach umbrella or find a spot on the beach where there is shade.
3 You should wear a hat as well as sunglasses.
4 You shouldn't stay out in the sun from 11:00 - 3:00 when the sun is very strong.
5 You shouldn't go swimming immediately after eating.
6 You shouldn't swim far away from the shore.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Butun tana va yuzingizga quyoshdan himoya kremi surtishingiz kerak. (NAMUNA)
2 Plyaj soyaboni olib borishingiz yoki soya joy topishingiz kerak.
3 Ko'zoynak bilan birga shlyapa ham kiyishingiz kerak.
4 Quyosh juda kuchli bo'lganda, 11:00-3:00 orasida quyoshda qolmasligingiz kerak.
